justification: The protocol states that SAP amendments would be completed before unblinding. The captured SAP version 3.0 is dated 23 July 2019 and specifies this dapagliflozin–placebo primary composite, time-to-first-event, ITT/FAS population, Cox model, covariates, censoring rules, and HR with 95% CI. The report's primary analysis and reported estimate correspond to that plan.

basis.source:
A comprehensive Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) will be developed prior to first patient
randomised and any subsequent amendments will be documented, with final amendments
completed prior to unblinding of the data.
The results of the key study outcome will be independently validated by an external statistical
team.
